title: Replace awaited per-row insert/update loops with Drift batch() in curriculum_scope_dao, stage_dao, and track_dao.purgeHistory

why: These four loops are all already inside a db.transaction() (so DB-2 is satisfied — no partial-write risk), but each issues N sequential awaited statements where Drift's batch() would send one. track_dao.purgeHistory is the worst case: on 'delete and wipe history' for a track with hundreds of completions, it round-trips once per row to stamp purgedAt instead of one batched UPDATE. The three sites from the companion DB-2 finding (point_config_dao.seedDefaults, study_day_config_dao.seedDefaults, track_learning_order_dao.upsertOrder) share the identical pattern and compound this once they're wrapped in a transaction.
recommendation: Convert each loop to `batch((b) { for (...) { b.insert(...)/b.update(...); } })`, which Drift supports for both inserts and per-row updates with distinct WHERE clauses inside one batch call.
acceptance_criteria: curriculum_scope_dao.setScopes, stage_dao.replaceStagesForTrack/replaceStagesForCurriculum, and track_dao.purgeHistory's tombstone step use batch() instead of a per-row await loop.
Existing tests for these methods pass unchanged (behavior-preserving refactor).
